inspiration: repipe round 4 need pe-data-directory-count; the shape already exists one format over, in loader/elf_shdr.rs -- object validates a header field eagerly, so repair the field in a copy of the bytes and hand that copy downstream
decisions: The refuter's hypothesis is UPHELD and its mechanism was exact: object-0.39.1 read/pe/data_directory.rs:30, reached eagerly from ImageNtHeaders::parse, slices exactly NumberOfRvaAndSizes entries out of the optional header, so no 'do not ask for the directories' path exists and every PE surface dies at File::parse.

Clamp to min(declared, (SizeOfOptionalHeader - 96 for PE32 / 112 for PE32+) / 8), not to a hard 16 -- what Windows does. On the witness that recovers the 16 genuine directory slots that are physically present (optsize 224 = 96 + 16*8), so the imports come from the real table (GetProcAddress/LoadLibraryA resolve) rather than a fabricated one.

The repair rides elf_shdr::read_image and console engine::bootstrap_from_object, the two points the ELF section-table repair already normalizes at, so every surface is covered without touching decompile_all.rs (held by a sibling builder this round).

Departure from the ELF sibling: the clamp is KEPT when the rewritten copy still does not parse, where tolerate_unusable_section_table discards itself. A count larger than its own optional header is unambiguously wrong however the rest of the file reads, so keeping it lets the caller report the error that is actually left instead of a header count that was never the whole story. Covered by an explicit unit test.
